// Code generated by contracts/cmd/errorcodegen. DO NOT EDIT.

package errors

type Code string

const (
	CodeInternalError Code = "INTERNAL_ERROR"
	CodeRateLimited   Code = "RATE_LIMITED"
)

const (
	ErrInternalError NamedError = NamedError(CodeInternalError)
	ErrRateLimited   NamedError = NamedError(CodeRateLimited)
)

func LookupDefinition(code Code) ErrorDefinition {
	switch code {
	case CodeInternalError:
		return ErrorDefinition{HTTPStatus: 500, Retryable: false, MessageVI: "Lỗi", MessageEN: "Error"}
	case CodeRateLimited:
		return ErrorDefinition{HTTPStatus: 429, Retryable: true, MessageVI: "Chậm lại", MessageEN: "Slow down"}
	default:
		return LookupDefinition(CodeInternalError)
	}
}
